name: Vendored Blosc+LZ4 Compression Pipeline
definition: A stripped-down, vendored compression/decompression pipeline for OpenVDB and NanoVDB sparse volume data, using only LZ4 as the compressor and non-threaded Blosc context methods.
summary: This pipeline embeds a minimal, non-threaded Blosc and LZ4 compressor directly into OpenVDB and NanoVDB, eliminating external dependencies while maintaining decompression performance comparable to the standard library.
